category_title: Socially isolated student with ADHD who struggles with behavioral regulation and seeks adult validation
minimal_context: Jacob is transitioning from eating lunch in the classroom to playing in the playground.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The bell just rang for the end of lunch. Everyone, please head out to the playground for your break.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Runs out into the playground, grabs a classmate's neck and twists their arm around)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Jacob, let go. The other boy is telling you to stop.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Watches the classmates distance themselves from him. Stands completely alone and stares into the sky.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What are you doing over here by yourself?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Approaches with tears starting to form in his eyes) I feel outside the classroom community.
